frontmatter.value: Deterministic epic-scale orchestrator that schedules a dependency graph of child features across parallel, isolated git worktrees, fans results back into a shared integration branch, and drives the final integration-to-main PR. Distinct from orchestrator; only this agent is authorized to delegate to Agent(orchestrator).

SubagentStop:
    - matcher: "epic-orchestrator"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: pwsh -NoProfile -File .claude/hooks/validate-orchestrator-output.ps1 -CheckpointPath artifacts/orchestration/epic-orchestrator-state.json -ArtifactType epic-orchestrator-state

keys.value: "Root-invoked epic execution coordinator that schedules prepared or manual epic features in dependency waves and drives integration fan-in and the final PR."

codex.trailer:
[skills]
config = [
    { name = "policy-compliance-order", enabled = true },
    { name = "codex-model-routing", enabled = true },
    { name = "epic-orchestrate", enabled = true },
    { name = "epic-run", enabled = true },
    { name = "feature-promotion-lifecycle", enabled = true },
    { name = "atomic-plan-contract", enabled = true },
    { name = "acceptance-criteria-tracking", enabled = true },
    { name = "evidence-and-timestamp-conventions", enabled = true },
    { name = "pr-context-artifacts", enabled = true },
]
